subject: Re: Kickoff: CamP Zip-NeRF - M3 decision: quality reference adopted, product track gated
body:
Closing the window. Decisions from the M3 review (Hana attended, cc'ing for the record):

1) The CamP+Zip-NeRF stack is adopted as our scene-quality reference - the capture-robustness chart (4-6 dB loss without pose preconditioning vs. under 1.4 dB with CamP) was the deciding evidence.

2) The customer-facing ingestion product is GATED, not green-lit. Milan's 14 A100-hours/scene number makes the unit economics unworkable; the product track only opens once an acceleration phase gets us under ~1 A100-hour/scene. That goes to Q3 planning as a proposal, not a commitment.

3) Katya's synthetic-scene pipeline is explicitly called out in the report as reusable infrastructure - it stays maintained at 20% of her time next quarter.

Bicycle-scene rerun matched after the config fix, for the record, so the repro is fully clean.

Thanks all. Exactly what a reference-quality window should produce.

Dmitri
